classification: informational - community/lab-anchored serving recipe, never a CONTRACT acceptance floor

model.revision_policy: pinned at fetch time by fetch-model.sh (recorded in models/<key>/REVISION.txt and the manifest); set a hash here once a first good run is recorded
model.license: OpenMDW-1.1 (permissive; verify on the model card at fetch time)
model.notes: hybrid Mamba-2 + MoE + Attention, 30B total / ~3B active (128 experts, 6 active), built-in MTP; the NVFP4 checkpoint deploys on Ampere (sm_80) via documented W4A16 fallback kernels - that fallback path is what the anchors measured. Alternative W4A16-only quants exist (GotoAI-Inc 20.49 GB; useful-quants 16.60 GiB g64) - unverified by us.

engine.name: vllm
engine.version_policy: minimum - the official vLLM recipe's mamba/humming/async flags postdate 0.27.x; exact wheel re-pinned in REVISION.txt after the first successful launch (smoke-model fails loudly on unknown flags)

serve.notes: flags from the official vLLM recipe (recipes.vllm.ai), with --mamba-ssu-algorithm horizontal -> simple: BOTH default ssu variants require SM90 (flashinfer kernel_selective_state_update_stp.cuh:1342, 'Vertical/horizontal require FLASHINFER_MAMBA_ENABLE_SM90') - fatal at cudagraph capture on our sm_80 card [measured 2026-10-30]. A/B on the rented 170HX: explicit simple vs omitting the flag are identical within noise (decode256 212.09 vs 212.08 tok/s, prefill 37544 vs 37870 tok/s) - simple is kept EXPLICIT so the kernel path stays pinned against engine-default drift. + GPU_UTIL 0.90 added per our <=0.90 conservative rule

speculative.draft_size: 967M-param dense GQA drafter (~small vs the 30B target)
speculative.status: not wired into smoke-model v1 - the anchors are speculation-off; per the lab matrix DSpark is the best method on this card (1.40-2.11x across 1k-128k, ~1.53x @16k -> ~349 tok/s implied) and would be the first extension

benchmark.protocol: vendor live_benchmark.py (usage-token-counted-v1) - the same three cases as the acceptance recipe
benchmark.comparability_note: anchors were measured with coding-style prompts at 16k/64k depth, 1024/2048-token outputs, speculation off - our standard three cases are for cross-model and cross-card comparison within OUR protocol only

long_context.config: W4A16 fallback, vLLM, 300 W, speculation off, coding prompts (1024/2048-token outputs)
long_context.label: third-party lab sweep (it-still-boots.github.io) - the fastest model measured on this card

anchors.headline: fastest model measured on the CMP 170HX in the lab sweep; the tensor-core-gated GA100 favors its 3B-active hybrid architecture and the W4A16 weight path

cautions: engine flags are from the official recipe and newer than our acceptance stack (vLLM 0.27.1): smoke-model runs on a dedicated venv-<key>; an unknown flag aborts the launch - re-pin the wheel and record it
W4A16 here is the Ampere FALLBACK of the NVFP4 checkpoint, not native FP4 math
the anchors are 300 W lab numbers; our sessions run at a 180 W cap - expect proportionally lower absolute tok/s (the acceptance recipe lost ~5% from 255 W to 180 W)
thermal: passively cooled card - the fail-closed guard stops the smoke at 80/85 C
DSpark/MTP would lift decode but the anchor methodology is speculation-off; keep baselines comparable

engine pin is vllm-ONLY (>= minimum, not a lock): torch/transformers/flashinfer float with vllm's deps, so informational numbers are not auditable across engine micro-versions - re-pin a verify_versions block if cross-session auditability is ever needed
